info.title: PawFlow API
info.description:
REST API documentation for the PawFlow pet care service booking and provider management platform.

Cross-cutting contract (P3-BE11/BE12): every response carries `X-Request-ID`; every operation except `/api/health/*` is subject to the API-wide rate limits (`429 RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`, `503 RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE` when the limiter store is unavailable). Errors use the `ErrorResponse` shape. IDs are strings (PostgreSQL BIGINT); NUMERIC values are strings with 2 decimals.

password.description: Account password. The password is never returned by the API.
